records.falsifier: A request with fully bound message evidence still exceeds its reserved input, or absent messages continue contributing.
records.mechanism: Add exact-message receipt-bound reasoning reservation to tokenizer measurement and existing margin; discard contribution when message is absent.

records.statement: Reserving reported reasoning tokens only for included assistant messages covers retained-reasoning input discrepancies in the bounded adapter.
